title: Anthos: Grounded
description: Meant to be a gritty survival rpg-like experience with Cobblemon, fusing the two genres in a unique and exciting way. A lot of survival mods took inspiration from the Aged modpack.
body: Anthos: Grounded is a look into a different side of Anthos, one featuring the playful and whimsical nature of Cobblemon, with the grittier elements of hard survival. RPG elements have been added to encourage exploration and personal development, while tempting players to try new things while surviving everything else. Survival elements inspired by the Aged modpack, but with some tweaks to personal taste. This is meant to be a fusion between two beloved fandoms while trying something new we haven't seen before.
